2610.10154.title: HySPE: Positional Encoding via Symplectic Dual Shears
2610.10154.paper_summary: We introduce Hyperbolic Symplectic Positional Encoding (HySPE), grounding positional attention in non-compact symplectic transformations. While canonical Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) parameterizes the compact, elliptic branch of $\Sp(2,\R)$ via rotations, HySPE operationalizes its hyperbolic branch via a damped symmetric composition of dual shears, yielding a conformally symplectic contraction with two spectral decay rates per channel pair. To eliminate the exponential representation drift inherent to naive absolute factorizations, we diagonalize the operator in its invariant eigenbasis and introduce blockwise coordinate rebasing with adaptive centered execution. This guarantees length-independent numerical bounds while matching cached RoPE forward latency (7.21\,ms on an RTX 4090). On TinyShakespeare, HySPE-UltraLong maintains an invariant perplexity of 4.810 up to $16\times$ zero-shot extrapolation ($L=4096$), whereas RoPE degrades to 131.198. Scaled to a 51M-parameter subword Transformer on WikiText-103 ($L_{\text{train}}=512$), HySPE closely matches RoPE in-domain while robustly extrapolating to length 8192, reducing tail perplexity by 83.9\% over RoPE. While these controlled experiments establish HySPE's extrapolation robustness and numerical stability, evaluating its scaling behavior on large-scale foundation models remains an important direction for future investigation.
2610.10154.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹超雙曲對稱位置編碼（HySPE），將位置注意力基於非緊湊的對稱變換。雖然經典的旋轉位置嵌入（RoPE）通過旋轉參數化了$\Sp(2,\R)$的緊湊橢圓分支，HySPE則通過雙剪切的阻尼對稱組合來操作其雙曲分支，產生每對通道具有兩個頻譜衰減率的共形對稱收縮。為了消除天真的絕對分解所固有的指數表示漂移，我們在其不變特徵基底中對運算符進行對角化，並引入自適應中心執行的區塊坐標重基準化。這保證了與長度無關的數值界限，同時匹配緩存的RoPE前向延遲（在RTX 4090上為7.21毫秒）。在TinyShakespeare上，HySPE-UltraLong在$16\times$零-shot外推（$L=4096$）中保持不變的困惑度4.810，而RoPE則降至131.198。擴展到WikiText-103上的51M參數子詞Transformer（$L_{\text{train}}=512$），HySPE在域內與RoPE緊密匹配，同時在長度8192上穩健外推，將尾部困惑度降低了83.9\%，相較於RoPE。雖然這些受控實驗確立了HySPE的外推穩健性和數值穩定性，但評估其在大規模基礎模型上的擴展行為仍然是未來研究的重要方向。
